content.value_statement: React Native async bugs can hide in state actions, effects, and promise chains. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through focused async reviews and safer sequencing decisions.
actual_capabilities: Identifies floating promise risks in React Native async flows.
Reviews Zustand actions for hidden promise timing issues.
Explains when async operations should run sequentially or in parallel.
Checks useEffect async patterns for cleanup and race-condition safety.
Recommends TypeScript ESLint rules for promise-related mistakes.
limitations: It is a guidance-only skill and does not run tests by itself.
It focuses on React Native, Expo, Zustand, and TypeScript patterns.
It cannot prove runtime behavior without project code and test results.
It does not replace a full application security review.

use_cases.title: Debug Retake Flow Timing
use_cases.description: Find missing awaits and unsafe sequencing in a user flow that updates Zustand state before loading dependent data.

use_cases.title: Harden Async Code Review
use_cases.description: Use a checklist for promise handling, post-condition validation, useEffect cleanup, and ordered state changes before release.

use_cases.title: Tune Promise Linting
use_cases.description: Select ESLint rules that catch floating promises, misused promises, missing awaits, and await on non-promises.

prompt_templates.title: Find Floating Promises
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one screen or hook
prompt_templates.prompt: Use rn-async-patterns to review this React Native file for async calls that are not awaited, returned, or intentionally ignored.

prompt_templates.title: Review Zustand Async Actions
prompt_templates.prompt: Use rn-async-patterns to inspect these Zustand actions for hidden promises, unsafe state timing, and missing post-condition checks.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Effects and Race Conditions
prompt_templates.prompt: Use rn-async-patterns to review these useEffect blocks for async callbacks, cleanup behavior, stale updates, and dependency-related race conditions.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Async Safety Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use rn-async-patterns to create a focused review plan for a React Native feature with async stores, API loading, and dependent operations.

output_examples.input: Review a retake flow that enables an area, clears answers, and loads new questions.
output_examples.output: The review flags a missing wait before clearing answers, explains the race, and recommends sequential execution with state validation.

output_examples.input: Inspect a component that loads data inside useEffect when the selected assessment changes.
output_examples.output: The result highlights the need for an inner async function, a cancellation guard, and error handling for failed loads.

output_examples.input: Assess promise linting for a React Native TypeScript project.
output_examples.output: The response recommends promise-focused ESLint rules and explains which async mistakes each rule can catch during development.

best_practices: Provide the relevant store, hook, or component code with surrounding async dependencies.
Ask for sequencing recommendations when operations share state or depend on each other.
Pair the review with tests or device logs when the bug only appears under timing pressure.
anti_patterns: Do not treat every promise as parallelizable because it improves speed.
Do not ignore a returned promise unless the fire-and-forget behavior is documented.
Do not assume Zustand actions are synchronous without checking their implementation.

faq.question: What projects is this skill best for?
faq.answer: It is best for React Native or Expo apps using TypeScript, async actions, hooks, and Zustand state.

faq.question: Can it fix my code automatically?
faq.answer: It can recommend edits and explain the safer pattern. The agent still needs access to your project files to make changes.

faq.question: Does it require Zustand?
faq.answer: No. Zustand examples are included, but the async sequencing guidance also applies to hooks, services, and promise chains.

faq.question: Will it catch all race conditions?
faq.answer: No. It improves review coverage, but tests, logs, and runtime reproduction are still needed for complex timing bugs.

faq.question: Why does it mention ESLint rules?
faq.answer: The rules help teams catch floating promises and misused promises before timing bugs reach runtime testing.

faq.question: Is it useful for backend TypeScript?
faq.answer: Some promise guidance transfers, but the examples and lifecycle advice focus on React Native components and mobile state flows.
